responsibility: This header declares `xml::printer`, GCC’s incremental XML-building helper for appending nodes beneath a current insertion point while tracking a stack of open elements. It provides push/pop tag operations, attribute setting, text and raw-XML insertion, direct element/node appending, and RAII helpers that verify balanced nesting or automatically scope a pushed element. Its responsibility is the convenience construction API for building XML subtrees procedurally on top of the lower-level node classes from `xml.h`.
